description: This file declares functions related to port isolation configuration for the RTL8367C switch chip, including setting and getting permitted port masks and EFID values.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicPortIsolationPermittedPortmask
methods.description: Sets the permitted port mask for port isolation on a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPortIsolationPermittedPortmask
methods.description: Retrieves the permitted port mask for port isolation on a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicPortIsolationEfid
methods.description: Sets the EFID (Ethernet Function ID) for port isolation on a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPortIsolationEfid
methods.description: Gets the EFID (Ethernet Function ID) for port isolation on a specific port.
